dedupe_keys.name: pecan street dataport high resolution residential electricity solar ev and water use data from volunteer homes

description: Pecan Street Dataport is the data service of Pecan Street Inc., a research organisation based in Texas, and describes itself as the world's largest resource for residential energy use data. The Dataport page read on 2026-09-26 says it holds ultra-high-resolution energy and water data from a network of volunteer participant homes, expanded to residential water use, electric transportation and regenerative agriculture, with ancillary data such as demographics and home audits, and that users should download a metadata document and data dictionary to understand the structure. Access is through a Dataport account, with separate pages for licences and pricing and for Dataport terms and conditions, which were not read; the licensing page returned 404 on that day. Coverage is volunteer homes in the United States. Caveats: participants are self-selected, and the access terms were not read. Simulation uses are appliance- and circuit-level load profiles for household demand, rooftop solar and EV charging models and demand response studies. Related records: data-low-carbon-london-smart-meter-households is a comparable UK smart meter dataset.
